name: Han's Laser Technology Industry Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Han's Laser Technology Industry Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, researches, develops, produces, and sells intelligent manufacturing equipment in China and internationally. It offers laser marking machines, such as fiber laser marking, UV laser marking, flying marking machine, PCBA and IC and Wafer marking, picosecond laser marking machine, and CO2 laser marking; laser cutting machine, such as sheet metal cutting, wafer and PCBA cutting, precision cutting, and wire-stripping, as well as PV industry; and laser welding machines comprising precision welding, YAG welder, fiber laser welder, mold repair welder, jewelry dot welding machine, and semiconductor laser source.
